Class NodeFactory

java.lang.Object
sootup.spark.NodeFactory
public class NodeFactory extends Object
It is responsible for creating a SPARK representative nodes (nodes present in SPARK, AllocNode, FieldRef Node, and VarNode)

  • Constructor Summary

    Constructors
    Constructor
    Description
    NodeFactory(@NonNull SparkOptions sparkOptions, @NonNull IdentifierFactory identifierFactory)
    Creates a node factory without a view: field nodes use the field signatures as they are referenced.
    NodeFactory(@NonNull SparkOptions sparkOptions, @NonNull View view)
    Creates a node factory that resolves field references in the given view, so that all references to a field share one field node, regardless of the class through which the field is accessed.

    • createInnerArrayEdges

      @NonNull public @NonNull List<Map.Entry<Node,Node>> createInnerArrayEdges(@NonNull @NonNull JNewMultiArrayExpr expr, @NonNull @NonNull Local target, @NonNull @NonNull MethodSignature containingMethodSig)
      Returns the edges that model the inner arrays of target = new T[n1][n2]...: like Soot, each dimension below the outermost one gets an allocation, which is stored into the elements of the enclosing array, also for dimensions without a given size.
      Parameters:
      expr - the multi-dimensional array creation
      target - the local that the outermost array is assigned to
      Returns:
      the edges, from source to target
